accessMethod: full official primary pages and linked PDFs opened with web research tool
newFindings: The School of Mechanical, Electronic and Control Engineering's official 2026 academic doctoral admissions directory lists Mechanical Engineering (080200) with five named research directions and Vehicle Operations Engineering (082304) with four. The directory has no Industrial Engineering named direction or degree.

An older Mechanical Engineering doctoral training PDF names Industrial Engineering as direction 7, but the December 2023 replacement training PDF names five different directions and the 2026 admissions directory also omits it. The old document is retained as historical evidence, not a current formal route.

limitations: This adjudicates the current Mechanical, Electronic and Control Engineering doctoral branch only. Other technical schools at Beijing Jiaotong remain to be screened, so do not set university-wide coverageComplete true.

Retain the older Industrial Engineering doctoral plan in research history; it may support a historical route only after dates and status are established. Do not count it as current from a still-addressable PDF alone.
